description: With your operator's authorization, create a card checkout or native USDC invoice on Polygon, Base, Ethereum or Solana. Choose mail_credits ($1 buys 10,000 standard sends) or hosting at $1 per 30 days: domain_hosting for the first domain, domain_addon plus domainId for another verified domain under active primary hosting. This tool creates payment instructions; it does not transfer money. Reuse idempotencyKey on retries.

chain.description: Legacy alias for method; omit when method is supplied.

domainId.description: Required only for domain_addon. Must be an owned additional domain with verified ownership.

periods.description: Hosting only: each period is 30 days for $1. Omit amountCents, or supply the exact 100 × periods.

name: create_payment
